author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Google just dropped a massive wave of AI updates for the Gemini app, completely overhauling the interface and introducing actual autonomous agents that can run tasks in the background.

In this exclusive interview, I sit down with Jeff Huang, the head of engineering for the Gemini app, to find out exactly how these new features work. We break down everything from the ground-up UI rebuild powered by the "Neural Expressive" design language (and iOS Liquid Glass) to the brand-new underlying engine driving advanced multimodal capabilities: the Omni model.

But the absolute biggest announcement from the engineering team is a brand-new feature called Spark. Jeff explains how Spark fundamentally shifts Gemini from a simple chatbot into a true autonomous assistant that can execute multi-step workflows, handle your "Daily Brief," and run scheduled automations called "heartbeats".

title: Inside Google Gemini’s Massive AI Overhaul with Head of Engineering
